summary: Iter 8 verified end-to-end: GET /api/stats/week + manifest/service-worker + WeeklyTrend + InstallPrompt + OfflineBanner all pass. 5/5 new pytest cases green; 19/19 iter7 regression also green. UI dashboard renders 7-bar mini-trend (1,455 mi · 4 trips · best 540) with today=orange, others=blue; install prompt fires on synthetic beforeinstallprompt and writes tm_install_dismissed_at on dismiss; offline banner toggles to online-pulse on online event. RTI brand-separation invariant holds.

backend_iter8.TestStatsWeekSeeded::test_seeded_distrib: PASS (1455 mi total, 4 trips, max 540, today=320, day-1=415, day-3=180, day-5=540)

critical_code_review_comments: /app/backend/server.py is 747 lines — approaching the 700-line guideline. Consider splitting routers (stats, achievements, trips, auth) into separate modules in a future cleanup iter; not blocking.
WeeklyTrend computes `Math.max(1, ...(days.map(d=>d.miles) || [0]))` — the `|| [0]` only fires if .map returns falsy, which it never does. Harmless; could simplify.
service-worker.js fetch handler returns undefined for non-GET /api/* requests (intended pass-through), which is correct browser behavior. OK.

InstallPrompt: when `isiOS()` is false AND `beforeinstallprompt` never fires, component renders nothing. That is correct behavior, just noting that headless desktop Chromium without a real install ledger is silent — only the synthetic-dispatch test verifies the UI.
test_credentials: Test user injected via mongosh per /app/memory/test_credentials.md. Cleaned up post-run. session_token=tm_iter8_e2e_session_<ts>
seed_data_creation: Test fixture seeds 4 finished trips (today=320, day-1=415, day-3=180, day-5=540) with time_zone=UTC for deterministic bucketing; cleaned up after test. E2E test user + 4 trips also injected via mongosh and cleaned up.
context_for_next_testing_agent: Iter 8 is fully green. Pytest harness pattern: set REACT_APP_BACKEND_URL+MONGO_URL+DB_NAME env vars before invoking pytest. The frontend continue-dialog (data-testid='continue-yes-btn') only appears if the seeded user has an ACTIVE (not finished) trip session — for iter8 we only seeded finished trips so the dialog did not appear. Note: service worker is registered ONLY in production builds — only /service-worker.js reachability + cache version were asserted (per E1's note). beforeinstallprompt was successfully dispatched as synthetic CustomEvent and the InstallPrompt picked it up.
